args.summary: Deploy of v2.3.1 to checkout-api (all production regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west) began failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Per runbook, rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified: service is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with error rate reduced to 0.2%. v2.3.1 must not be redeployed until the root cause is identified and fixed; note v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Follow-up: investigate v2.3.1 failure cause.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback:**
- Deploy history showed v2.3.1 (the latest production deploy) was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0 — verified healthy, error rate now 0.2%.

**Incident:**
- Opened **INC-0002 (SEV2)** for checkout-api, paging the on-call engineer. It documents the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, verification of recovery, and a follow-up to investigate the root cause before any redeploy. (Worth noting: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, which may help root-cause analysis.)
